question: Name the captain of the Indian men's hockey team, as on January 2021:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manpreet Singh Pawar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Manpreet Singh Pawar- the captain of the Indian men's hockey team, as on January 2021**.

 
 
• **He led the Indian field hockey team to the bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
 
• He plays as a halfback.
 
 
 
• The Indian men's national field hockey team represents India in international Field hockey competitions and is governed by Hockey India.
 
 
• **The Indian hockey team won the gold medal while making its debut in the 1928 Olympics.**
 
• The Indian hockey team won the gold medal in the Olympic Games six times consecutively between 1928 and 1956.
 
• The other two gold medals were won in Tokyo in 1964 and Moscow Olympics in 1980.
